title: A three-step mechanism
caption: Each step has its own transition state, with an intermediate between steps. The step with the highest transition state, here the second, is rate-determining.
alt: Profile with three humps and two intermediates; the second hump is highest.
description: Step 1: a low barrier to intermediate 1.
Step 2: the highest transition state, rate-determining.
Step 3: a small barrier to the products.
